whatThisIs: Decisions by the decision owner about what a route may deliver at all. This is a different question from whether a packet is complete: a packet can be internally perfect and still deliver the wrong instrument, and no amount of proof about its bytes answers that. A refusal here outranks a packet proof, because the proof was of an artifact the owner has said may not be delivered.
howItIsApplied: generate.mjs reads this file. A family with a live refusal is placed in WRONG_DELIVERY_TYPE ahead of every proven state, so it cannot sit in COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN, cannot enter a route cohort, and cannot carry commercial eligibility. Payment was already fail-closed and stays so.

decisions.decision: LegalEase may not replace the mandatory SCCA 223A1 GS order form with its custom pleading.
whatWasMeasuredBeforeTheDecision: the string 223A1 appears in no file in the family directory and nowhere in the rendered canonical fixture; the only form the packet names is SCCA 223C, on one route
the rendered componentSet carries no official_form_reference, no records_checklist and no fee_instrument_schedule on any route, while production-field-map.json declares each of them nine times
eleven of the twelve tracks in the SC legal design memo carry destination.kind prosecutor, and the rendered packet is captioned IN THE ......... COURT and asks this court for relief

the memo states for every route that the composed package is not a substitute for the official order form, and that section 17-22-930 makes the solicitor's blank form mandatory and to the exclusion of all other expungement forms
consequences: removed from the first Grade A route cohort
COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN invalidated; the family is WRONG_DELIVERY_TYPE
every affected route removed from custom-pleading commercial eligibility

theSplitTreatmentOrdered.A: Where the mandatory official form is available and participant-filed: use the official form, include every required supporting component, the official-form reference, the records checklist and the fee-instrument schedule, give accurate solicitor-destination instructions, then build and independently verify.
theSplitTreatmentOrdered.B: Where the solicitor supplies, controls or initiates the mandatory form: HANDOFF_READY or GUIDANCE_READY, naming the correct solicitor's office and what the participant must bring or request, stating plainly that LegalEase does not replace the solicitor's mandatory form, with packet checkout disabled.
theSplitTreatmentOrdered.C: Only routes genuinely filed as court petitions may use a court-captioned pleading seeking relief from the court.

whatMayNotBeDone: preserving the current custom pleading because it already has fixtures and visual bundles
a cosmetic repair on a wrong delivery type
decisions.visualReviewInstruction: Neither South Carolina bundle is to be reviewed. Both were published before this decision and are superseded by it.

decisions.decision: GUIDANCE / OUT-OF-SCOPE STANDS. A completed packet does not override the controlling route-ratification decision. Keep the packet as an internal review fixture and keep checkout disabled unless a later route-specific owner or counsel approval expressly authorizes packet delivery.
decisions.theQuestionAsked: Counsel's route-ratification registry records this route's approved service behaviour for this release as guidance only, or as deliberately out of scope, while a complete packet family exists for it. Is the completed packet the approved treatment for this route, or does the guidance-only / out-of-scope determination stand and the family remain an internal review fixture?
consequences: not COMPLETE_PACKET_PROVEN; the family is WRONG_DELIVERY_TYPE
decisions.whatWouldReopenIt: A later route-specific owner or counsel approval expressly authorising packet delivery on this route. Nothing the factory measures reopens it.
